metadata.title: Endpoint Lifecycle

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing the full lifecycle of endpoint trust, including enrollment, transition, suspension, recovery, and retirement.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Endpoint provisioning systems, asset lifecycle management, decommissioning workflows, and trust state management.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Governance pattern defining how endpoint trust is established, transitioned, suspended, and terminated over time.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Endpoint lifecycle governance applies only to endpoints that satisfy Endpoint Core trust requirements.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Endpoint lifecycle governance aligns with system lifecycle management and continuous authorization principles.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Endpoint retirement, reset, and integrity restoration align with media sanitization and platform resilience guidance.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust requires explicit management of device trust entry, suspension, and reauthorization.

metadata.remarks: Endpoint Lifecycle defines how endpoint trust is consciously managed over time. This pattern governs when endpoints enter trust, how trust transitions occur, when trust is suspended, how recovery is handled, and how trust is permanently terminated. It does not configure endpoints, detect threats, or evaluate compliance.

components.title: Endpoint Trust Enrollment
components.description: Establishes initial endpoint trust through controlled enrollment and identity binding.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized or unmanaged devices attempting to enter trusted state.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Formal enrollment prevents unauthorized trust entry.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Endpoint trust objectives and enrollment procedures are defined and approved.

components.title: Trust State Transition
components.description: Controls transitions between endpoint trust levels (e.g., COBO L1 to L2).

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation of device state to illicitly gain higher trust.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Governed transition processes prevent unauthorized trust escalation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Interconnections and trust relationships are explicitly authorized.

components.title: Trust Suspension
components.description: Temporarily suspends endpoint trust in response to compromise, health degradation, or investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence of access despite degraded or compromised endpoint state.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Trust suspension removes endpoint eligibility without destruction.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security incidents result in controlled suspension of endpoint trust.

components.title: Trust Recovery and Reauthorization
components.description: Restores endpoint trust following remediation and verification.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence of corrupted state following incomplete recovery.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Verified re‑enrollment ensures clean trust restoration.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Endpoint recovery procedures enable trusted restoration.

components.title: Endpoint Trust Retirement
components.description: Permanently terminates endpoint trust and ensures secure decommissioning.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Residual data or credentials remaining after endpoint retirement.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Definitive decommissioning and sanitization prevent reuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Endpoint components and data are securely sanitized upon retirement.
